purpose: Teach: 同性/宣教師/レッテル/滅び/検察庁/結社/投融資/自虐

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、同性パートナーシップ社員制度を導入しろ
lines.en: We're implementing a same-sex partnership employee benefits program.
lines.style: Measured, executive-level directive. Clipped pace. No room for negotiation. The tone of someone stating policy, not opinion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外進出時、宣教師の歴史にも学びます
lines.en: Yes. We'll also learn from the history of overseas expansion and international best practices.
lines.style: Thoughtful acknowledgment. Deliberate pacing. Careful word choice — showing he's already considered implications. Respectful, not deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合からのレッテルにも揺るがれるな
lines.en: And don't let competitive pressure or external criticism shake the company's values.
lines.style: Steady, protective tone. Emphasis on 'don't' — not harsh, but firm. The conviction of someone who has weathered criticism before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業時の理念が滅びぬよう継承いたします
lines.en: Understood. We'll uphold the founding principles as we move forward.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Slower cadence — showing the weight he understands this carries. Not perfunctory; genuinely absorbing the responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、検察庁の指導には誠実に従え
lines.en: And we'll comply fully with regulatory oversight from the prosecutor's office.
lines.style: Direct, businesslike. No hedging. The clarity of someone stating legal fact. Steady eye-contact level in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。反社的結社との取引は厳禁としております
lines.en: Yes. We have strict policies against any dealings with organized crime or illicit networks.
lines.style: Factual, slightly protective. The tone of someone ensuring the record is clear. Firm without being defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外投融資の機会を逃すな
lines.en: And don't overlook opportunities for strategic overseas investment.
lines.style: Brief, purposeful. Light forward momentum. The practical reminder of a leader balancing ethics with business growth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の自虐的発言には心のケアを提供します
lines.en: Yes. We provide mental health support for our employees, especially when they're struggling.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Thoughtful pace. The recognition that policy matters because people matter. Soft, genuine finish.
